node.statement: By node 1.2.1, q is nonnegative and sum_{a=1}^n q_a=1; by node 1.2.2 it vanishes outside S. Thus q_S is nonnegative and sum_{a in S} q_a=1. Together with row-stochasticity of G from node 1.1.2 and q_S G=q_S from node 1.2.3.2, this says exactly that q_S is a stationary probability row for G.
